interpolation: Bilinear on numeric metre heights decoded from archived Terrarium PNG256 at zoom 12, using WebMercator pixel centres and real neighbours across tile seams. Not directly sampled from original WEBP512; no generated or filled points.

source.name: Mapterhorn / Copernicus GLO-30
source.license: Copernicus WorldDEM-30 Full, Free & Open licence (included)
source.sourceAcquisitionPeriod: TanDEM-X 2011–2015; some infill elevations can be older
source.verticalDatum: Copernicus GLO-30 source: EGM2008; no independent datum transformation validated
source.sourceSelectionNote: Global GLO-30 source, inferred from Mapterhorn published source coverage; endpoint does not expose per-pixel source IDs.

processing.archivedTileReduction: Decode Terrarium512 to meters, average 2x2 scalar heights, encode TerrariumPNG256; no RGB interpolation
processing.missingDataPolicy: Fail on missing tiles, unavailable neighbours, invalid values or hash mismatches; never clamp or fill.
